queryGroup.name: experimental: tech stock and sales shares by region

supplyDemandQuery.title: calculated output-based emission factors by tech
supplyDemandQuery.comments: Output-based emission factors (emissions / primary physical output), aggregated across all vintage years for CO2, NOx, SO2, PM2.5, PM10, CO, NH3. Units are emiss_unit/output_unit (e.g. MTC/EJ).

supplyDemandQuery.title: calculated energy intensity by tech (input / primary output)
supplyDemandQuery.comments: Energy intensity per technology (total energy inputs / primary physical output), aggregated across all vintage years. Excludes water routing inputs. Units are input_unit/output_unit (e.g. EJ/EJ).

supplyDemandQuery.title: calculated energy intensity by tech (primary output / input)
supplyDemandQuery.comments: Efficiency per technology (primary physical output / total energy inputs), aggregated across all vintage years. Excludes water routing inputs. Units are output_unit/input_unit (e.g. EJ/EJ).

supplyDemandQuery.title: calculated stock share by tech within subsector (%)
supplyDemandQuery.comments: Sales share per technology as a percentage of subsector total primary output, aggregated across all vintage years. A value of 100 means the technology supplies all output in its subsector. Units are %.

supplyDemandQuery.title: calculated sales share by tech within subsector (%)
supplyDemandQuery.comments: Sales share per technology as a percentage of subsector total primary output, aggregated across all vintage years. A value of 100 means the technology supplies all output in its subsector. Units are %.

supplyDemandQuery.title: calcuated stock share by tech within sector (%)
supplyDemandQuery.comments: Stock share per technology as a percentage of sector total primary output in each model year, summing across all operating vintages. For model year Y, compares each technology's cumulative output (all installed vintages still operating) against the sector total. Technologies sum to 100% within each sector in each year. Units are %.

supplyDemandQuery.title: calculated sales share by tech within sector (%)
supplyDemandQuery.comments: Sales share per technology as a percentage of sector total new-vintage output for each vintage year. For vintage year X, compares only the output of the vintage-X installation of each technology against the sum of all technologies' vintage-X output in year X across the whole sector (not restricted to subsector). Units are %.
